verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an LLM product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no product-level controls for retention, deletion, or data-handling policy. Being able to run the weights locally or on edge devices is a deployment option: any retention control there comes from the user's own setup, not from Llama, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
